requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

3375-4399-4770--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4770--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

240-5470-6965-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-5470-6965-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2174-2645-3430-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2174-2645-3430-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3841-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3841-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3263-4186-6824-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3263-4186-6824-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

457-3490-6792.description:
Cast Animation Module by paying {1}.
When Animation Module enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Urza's first ability by tapping an artifact you control, adding {U}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3536-5078-7719.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2974-3942-4872.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a creature spell using Karador this turn.
2974-3942-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Repository Skaab either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1170-1171-5434.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-5434.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2654-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon
1618-2440-2654-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Shark Typhoon triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2654-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6633-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-6633-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

4771-5060-5660.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
4771-5060-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2478-2866-4986-5231.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2173-3200-4195-4574.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Resolve the Urza's Bauble ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Urza's Bauble from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1829-2173-4905-5220.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1580-2060-2292-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-2292-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

2781-3668.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Flesh Duplicate.
2781-3668.description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Flesh Duplicate enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Flesh Duplicate. Choose to have Flesh Duplicate enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

2196-2821-5621-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2196-2821-5621-5803.description:
Activate Arid Archway and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Arid Archway and another land.
Activate Arid Archway and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-4616-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-4616-6249--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

225-1479-4862-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-4862-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Omnath trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Omnath and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4730-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token copy of Sparring Mummy.
4730-5470.description:
Create a token copy of Sparring Mummy.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Sparring Mummy copy.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 2.

2423-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token copy of Bounding Krasis.
2423-5470.description:
Create a token copy of Bounding Krasis.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Bounding Krasis copy.
When the Bounding Krasis token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 2.

1018-2061-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
1018-2061-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Skullwinder.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4871-5256-5695-6019.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities from steps 3 and 7, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creatures' combined power.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-3542-6060.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{W}.
1170-3542-6060.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{W}.
Cast Forced Worship by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Forced Worship spell.
Activate Forced Worship by paying {2}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1692-2103-5730.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Aberrant Mind Sorcerer.
1692-2103-5730.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Aberrant Mind Sorcerer with haste.
When the Aberrant Mind Sorcerer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to roll a d20 and either return Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand, or put Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou if it was put on top of your library.
Repeat.

2757-3356-4498.notablePrerequisites:
You have the highest life total.
You control at least one basic Swamp.
2757-3356-4498.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Each Polyraptor you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Polyraptor.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped Polyraptor, untapping the basic Swamp.
Repeat.

1987-3821-4125.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3821-4125.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Peregrine Drake.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1987-3821-4125.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

1494-2646-4499.notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
1494-2646-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Sage of Hours and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

678-1872-4924.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem by paying {4}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

814-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-4478.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1707-3356-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You have the highest life total.
1707-3356-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Last Laugh, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the damaged Polyraptor, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

717-858-1742.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Nightmare Void, adding {B}.
Bone Miser's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Nightmare Void from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

66-2793-4988.notablePrerequisites:
Tamiyo's Compleation attached to Ugin's Nexus.
Artificer Class is level three.
66-2793-4988.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Artificer Class triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2026-3573-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
You control at least two artifacts.
2026-3573-4222.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.
